llms_txt.summary: AI Tastemakers publishes a daily pick of the open source AI projects gaining the most GitHub stars over the past 7 days, each with a short brief on what it does and why it matters now. Its sister list, Skill Tastemakers, does the same for agent skills, the add-ons that teach tools like Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex new tricks. Weekly reviews and monthly rollups sum up the trends. The Tastemakers Lab tests changes to the site in the open and publishes every result, good or bad. Written for builders deciding what to try next.
llms_txt.full_intro: This site is generated from the ai-tastemakers repository. Daily briefs rank repos by seven-day star growth and include Claude-written summaries. The Lab documents experiments on digest writing, layout, and discovery.
